name: cbct-reading-v2
description: ReadX — Go 后端 + React 前端 + Electron 壳（npm workspaces）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cbct/shared && npm run build -w @cbct/web && npm run build -w @cbct/desktop && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-release.ps1 && npm run package:windows -w @cbct/desktop
scripts.build:release:publish: npm run build && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-release.ps1 && npm exec --workspace=@cbct/desktop -- electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish always
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cbct/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cbct/web && npm run typecheck -w @cbct/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test -w @cbct/shared && npm run typecheck
